_comment: State for the monthly invoice run. 'last' records what actually went out, so the
next run bumps from a real sent invoice rather than from whatever a Doc happens to say.
Update this file at the end of every run and commit it.
'cycle': next_month = billed in advance (invoice dated the 1st covers that same month).
prev_month = billed in arrears (invoice dated the 1st covers the month just ended).
